app.name: karuki
app.tagline: Upload a song, get separated stems, and sing over the backing track

upload.title: Add a song
upload.hint: Any common audio format, up to 8 minutes.
upload.alreadyExisted: This song is already in the library, so it was not processed again.

player.notReady: This song is not ready to play yet.
player.failed: The stems could not be loaded.

controls.keyUp: Raise the key by a semitone
controls.keyDown: Lower the key by a semitone

library.title: My library
library.emptyHint: Once you upload a song it will appear here with its processing state.

job.playableHint: The lyrics are still loading, but the player is ready

errors.unsupported_format: That file type is not supported. Try MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG or OPUS.
errors.unreadable_audio: The file could not be read as audio. It may be damaged.
errors.no_audio_stream: The file has no audio track.
errors.unknown_duration: The length of the file could not be determined.
errors.song_too_long: The song is longer than 8 minutes. Try a shorter excerpt.
errors.normalisation_failed: The file could not be converted. Try another format.
errors.audio_tooling_missing: Processing is unavailable right now. That is our problem, not your file's.
errors.not_ingested: The song's file is missing. Try uploading it again.
errors.separation_failed: Separating the stems failed. You can try again.
errors.separation_unavailable: Separation is unavailable right now. That is our problem, not your file's.
errors.interrupted: Processing stopped part way through. You can start it again.
errors.job_not_retryable: That job cannot be run again.
errors.database_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.processing_unavailable: Processing cannot start right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. You can try again.
errors.stem_not_found: One of the song's stems was not found.
errors.stem_missing: The stem file is no longer in storage. The song needs processing again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. You can try again.
